name: io.github.PV-Bhat/vibe-check-mcp-server
description: Metacognitive AI agent oversight: adaptive CPI interrupts for alignment, reflection and safety

environment_variables.description: Gemini API key (default provider; at least one provider key is required)
environment_variables.name: GEMINI_API_KEY

environment_variables.description: Provider used when no modelOverride is supplied: gemini | openai | openrouter | anthropic (default: gemini)
environment_variables.name: DEFAULT_LLM_PROVIDER

environment_variables.description: Model of DEFAULT_LLM_PROVIDER to use when no modelOverride is supplied. Leave unset for the per-provider default (gemini-3.6-flash, gpt-5.6-terra, claude-sonnet-5). Required for openrouter.
environment_variables.name: DEFAULT_MODEL
